original.name: Unyielding Gatekeeper
rules: Disguise {1}{W} (You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.)

When {this} is turned face up, exile another target nonland permanent. If you controlled it, return it to the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, its controller creates a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.

78657ff4-cd10-4d8a-9c4d-8677b9ade319.name: Disguise: Unyielding Gatekeeper
rules: {this} becomes a 2/2 face-down creature, with no text, no name, no subtypes, and no mana cost.
Turn it face up any time for its disguise/cloaked cost.

A face-down creature that was cloaked or cast with disguise has ward {2}. (Whenever that creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)

e73c06c7-955e-4397-9e36-5e64f192b17d.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
